selection.metric: Lowest mean H1/H3/H5 episode-macro normalized MAE on existing validation windows with five consecutive transitions.
selection.candidate_groups: Group completed neural trials by run-id, method, hidden width, update budget and learning rate. Average predictions over all registered completed seeds in that group; do not select individual lucky seeds. Include validation-selected ridge.
selection.controls: Keep the strongest completed same-data JEPA and MLP configurations as controls, with seed counts, parameters and budgets explicit. This is not an architecture-only or FLOP-matched study.
selection.threshold_rule: For each pipeline independently, use the smallest score threshold producing no more than 1 percent empirical false positives on calibration episodes. A single increasing logistic calibration fitted on those episodes supplies Brier and reliability diagnostics. No test labels enter either fit.

comparison.new_population: Identical five-step-eligible causal windows for every method and every horizon; episode-macro prediction errors. Narrative identities are held out but primitive equations are shared.
comparison.historical_population: Previously opened paper final source families, restricted prospectively to episodes with five contiguous eligible transitions. H1/H3/H5 then use all contiguous eligible endpoints in those episodes. Recompute every comparator on identical rows; this is a regression check, not fresh confirmation or a verbatim reproduction of the paper's differently composed table.

historical_guardrail.comparison: best available paper ensemble at each endpoint
historical_guardrail.interpretation: point-estimate regression guard, not a statistical noninferiority claim

comparison.warning_labels: Any represented constraint breach in the five true future states. OS uses resource dimensions 0/1/3 >=0.95. Physical uses |x| or |y| >=1, battery or link <=0.08, or movement with clearance <=0.16. These labels are not vendor incident outcomes.

access.verification: Read retained final catalogs and recompute inference and metrics; never refit or rerun selection on a final catalog.

release.primary_success_rule: All four prediction endpoints and all historical guards pass. Secondary warning objective is reported separately and cannot be implied by prediction success.
